sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: The project includes the installation of a centre pivot irrigator capable of distributing irrigation water and recycled dairy effluent, together with two hard hose irrigators and associated pumping, electrical and control infrastructure. The system is intended to provide irrigation coverage across an approximate area of 45 to 55 hectares.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The Contractor is responsible for the complete design of the pump station and hydraulic system. The system must operate the centre pivot and both hard hose irrigators simultaneously at full design capacity while maintaining required flow rates and pressures.
Tenderers are to develop and submit irrigation designs for a proposed irrigated area between 45ha and 55ha using centre pivot and hard hose irrigation systems. The irrigation pump must be appropriately sized to meet the proposed demand. Tenderers must consider the available electrical supply at the pump site, which is limited to 200 amps and is a key design constraint.
Option 1 – Future Effluent Integration Design and install the irrigation network with suitable poly pipeline infrastructure to enable future connection of the existing effluent system. This option provides flexibility for future expansion and potential effluent integration. Connection locations and requirements will be confirmed during the site briefing.
Option 2 – Immediate Effluent Integration Connect the existing effluent system to the new irrigation network as part of the current works. Tenderers are to detail the infrastructure, controls and any additional requirements necessary to achieve full integration of the existing effluent supply. Connection points and pipeline alignments will be confirmed during the site briefing.
